bio.p1: Edinsson Adrian Melo Calvo is a Software Engineer with a background in the IT industry. He is passionate about exploring how technology can empower our personal and professional growth.
bio.p2: To understand who he really is, you have to go back to the beginning.
bio.p3: One of the memories that shaped his path the most was the first time he had a computer in front of him. He saw the Google search bar and found it simply intriguing. The little house icon in the browser, the links, and all the other icons made his imagination run wild about everything that could be behind it.
bio.p4: That computer was later a gift from his aunt. Curiously, it had Stronghold Crusader and his first Encarta installed. He read the whole Encarta. It opened an encyclopedia of things, games, and educational content that stimulated and opened a new world for him.
bio.p5: Stronghold Crusader was a strategy game about using available resources to build an empire. He got to play as an <link>Expert Player</link>.
bio.p6: That curiosity never went away. Over time it became his obsession, leading him to dive deep into this field.
bio.p7: He sees himself as someone looking for a life with more purpose and service.
